source_caveats: Detailed Note18 expresses the threshold as $60m annual royalties, then a 33%/67% split of excess royalties. This display follows the simplified 1%/~2% sales-rate disclosures and preserves both forms without claiming exact agreement.
A summary paragraph in PureTech FY2024 results names BMS for the $25m amount; detailed Note18 and Royalty Pharma SEC8-K identify Royalty Pharma as payer. Preserve this discrepancy.
3% of the rounded $10m BMS FY2024 launch sales is not an exact reconciliation of the reported $315k royalty. Do not infer missing precise sales or silently alter either source.
The scenario omits taxes, payment lags, legal adjustments, term limits, new milestones and other company economics. It does not calculate a net present value or investment return.
